description: This file implements an nftables-based proxy for Kubernetes, managing nftables rules and chains for service load balancing, endpoint management, and network policies, supporting dual-stack IPv4/IPv6 configurations.

classes.name: Proxier
classes.description: A Kubernetes proxy implementation using nftables for managing network rules and load balancing.

classes.name: servicePortInfo
classes.description: Represents service port details with precomputed chain names for nftables rules.

classes.name: endpointInfo
classes.description: Represents endpoint details with associated chain and affinity set names.

methods.name: NewProxier
methods.description: Creates a new nftables-based proxy for a specific IP family.

methods.name: setupNFTables
methods.description: Initializes nftables chains, tables, and rules for kube-proxy.

methods.name: syncProxyRules
methods.description: Synchronizes current proxy state with nftables rules.

methods.name: logFailure
methods.description: Logs failed nftables transactions with rate limiting.

methods.name: epChainSkipUpdate
methods.description: Determines if an endpoint chain requires updating.

methods.name: writeServiceToEndpointRules
methods.description: Creates nftables rules for service endpoints and session affinity.
